intro: Harbourline Credit Union's office, wired from the scan. The router, dns, plays the edge firewall here. The bench can't sinkhole a domain on the resolver: that block is done in the case. Here you do the cable and the firewall.

tasks.text: Take fin-lt04 off the network, but leave it switched on
tasks.hint: Pull its cable at the wall socket or shut its switch port. Its memory may still hold the tunnel's settings, so don't switch it off.

tasks.text: Copy the edge policy from fw_summary.txt onto the router: no laptop sends DNS or web traffic straight to the internet
tasks.hint: Click the router dns and write rules. Make a zone for the office, let only the proxy (10.70.0.5) out on tcp 80 and 443, then default deny. The router's own lookups aren't filtered, so the resolver keeps working.

tasks.text: Finance still works: fin-lt05 reaches the file server and the proxy, and the proxy reaches the web
tasks.hint: Ping from fin-lt05's terminal. If the proxy can't get out, your rules are too tight.
